Our Journey

About Prasanna Caterers

A family kitchen founded in Ahilyanagar that grew into Maharashtra's most trusted celebration caterer.

Who We Are

Authentic food that remembers home

Prasanna Caterers began in 1998 in Ahilyanagar, Maharashtra with traditional recipes for local weddings and family functions. Today, our mobile kitchens travel across Ahilyanagar district, Pune, Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar, Nashik, and across Maharashtra.

What has never changed is our strict insistence on cooking fresh at your venue — using pure ground spices, pure cow ghee, authentic Maharashtrian culinary methods, and FSSAI-certified hygiene protocols.

Milestones

Nearly three decades of Maharashtrian hospitality

  • 1998

    Smt. Prasanna & family prepare their first authentic Maharashtrian wedding feast for 250 guests in Ahilyanagar.

  • 2006

    First mobile kitchen unit rolls out, allowing live cooking on site across all venues in Maharashtra.

  • 2014

    Multi-cuisine repertoire expands with Live Chaat, Dosa, North Indian & Continental counters; team grows to 50+ culinary staff.

  • 2021

    State-of-the-art FSSAI-certified central prep facility opens in Savedi, Ahilyanagar with cold-chain logistics.

  • 2026

    Over 4,500 grand events served across Ahilyanagar & Maharashtra, still grinding masalas fresh every single morning.

Our Philosophy

Built on Uncompromising Values

Freshness

Vegetables sourced fresh every morning from local Ahilyanagar markets; spices ground on-site on the day of your event.

Hygiene

FSSAI certified central unit in Ahilyanagar, gloved service staff, stainless-steel mobile setup, and continuous health checks.

Maharashtrian Warmth

Traditional hospitality where every guest is treated like family; our staff ensures every plate is served with care.
